asr.full_text: Parye Bharrat Deshwasiyo Vidwan Kavi ne Likha Hai Main Vani ka Rajdeep hun Sach Pe Marne Wala hun Aur Dhaku ko Dhaku Kehne Ki Himmit Karne Wala Hun Uskavi Ka Mar Jaanahi Achcha Jo Hota, Khotdar Nahin Desh Jale aur Kuch Nahin Bolun Main Aesa Khotdar Nahin Dosto Bharat Verse Ki Andher ek Sabd Sunay Deta Hai let the country burn, I have nothing to say, I will not reveal anyone's proof Dear friends, A word is spoken in the State of India, CHAUKIDAR Dear people of India, Let me present to you with these words written by his wife Guru Ramkishan Tavar Ji I haven't mentioned any politician... Our Rishis, Munis, scriptures, Vedas have told that.. The person who has 8 qualities, they can be Chief Guard of the country Can save the country from resistance Friends without mentioning anything, we have tried to interpret the words spoken by Chauki I am leaving my message for you Who was truly a chauki? Who is a true chauki? Come and think on these words And take your own advice Mata datao of my beloved country and listen what it is And donate your Mata Don't give, don't donate, my dear countrymen Think carefully about this song and you don't donate For you and for Mother India and 125 million of countrymen i am presenting this song through Javanan Musics Friends, Jai Hind Jai Bharat Music My country's har-mat-dadda has learned this craft The God of my Country is so intelligent The God of my Country is so intelligent I am a guard for you too, you are one too I am a guard for youya, you bhi chowkidaar hai What is he doing? The one who is in charge of protection of the country The Thief sends the wicked people up to the prison People say he is a Tathag bandhan But they are getting scared Mother is ready to die My mother India says Get up, he is the real guard I am also a guard Brother, you are also a guard Music The guard would have said to him Who whistles on time Who celebrates Holi and Diwali Among the saints You enter the house and replace one with four You bring the ...and bring back Abhinandan from the clutches of his enemy They say to show proofs, but they are traitors Take these traitors one by one and make them leave the country I am a guard, brother... ...and you are one, too i too have no place or a place of stay you too also deserve an opportunity Music May their respect be praised by the people of hind, And may the 21st of June be celebrated by the world. may the pain of bewitched gods also be erased with art. You have won over your enemy Like lions, the lioness is an image of a red fort I'm a guard, and you'll serve as one Music Ram Kishan Naradev ki binti Mat daata swikar karo Apni vot ki kiimat samjo Bharat ka odhar karo Please understand the value of your vote Request for our freedom O people of India. Be careful of what you think Whoever's hands protect his country, stand by him O, Whoever's hands protect safe country, make him a guard The one who has a safe country, is a true warrior The one who has a safe country, is a true warrior I am a guard and you are a watchman Every measure in my country Has written the law of discipline Every state in my country Has written the law of discipline I am also a guard And you too are a guard I am also a guard I am also a guard And you are also a guard Every state of my country has written in its constitution What is the status of the state? Every state of my country has written in its constitution What is the status of the state? I am also a guard Don't get angry. I have told the master of the law... What are you waiting for? I have told him that I'm the master of the law. I have told the master of the law... My Master has explained... My master has explained my business as well as... My lord, you have a good manner. My lord, you have a good manner. My lord, you have a good manner. And I'm a guard of the court. So that our law, will be in our hands. What is the smartness of every person who has read and given a command? I am a guard and you are a guard Every law and order of my country has a good teacher I am a guard and you are also a guard Every state of my country and you are an officer too All the members of my country are educated and smart All the members of my country are educated and smart I am an a guard! As You are also a guard To the every mother and father, have written a law that your country is very happy You are a watchman You are a watchman You are a watchman You are also a guard I am also a guard And you are also a guard Every law of my country is written in the book Every law of my country is written in the book I am an employee of a job like you I am an employee of a job like you It's written as a law in my country It's written as a law in my country I am a guard and you are a guard I am a guard guard and so you are I am the security guard and so you are
